# High-voltage console captures

`pwr`, `unit`, `bat` and `info` replies from Pylontech high-voltage management
units on firmware B50 (4 modules) and B52.12.0 (8 modules).

Copied unchanged from the test samples of
[mletenay/home-assistant-pylontech](https://github.com/mletenay/home-assistant-pylontech)
(`tests/sample/`), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2023 mletenay.
